chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The takbīr in the two ʿĪd prayers is seven in the first [rakʿah] before the recitation, and in the second, five after the recitation.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: the saying of 'Allāhu akbar' within the prayer
key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the second rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two ʿĪds, namely ʿĪd al-Fiṭr and ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā

ai.seo_question: How many takbīrs are recited in Salat al-ʿĪdayn and when are they said?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number and placement of the takbīrs in Salat al-ʿĪdayn. It establishes that there are seven takbīrs in the first rakʿah before the recitation and five in the second rakʿah after the recitation, reflecting a specific jurisprudential ruling in the prayer of the two ʿĪds.
